corrections.reason: The fourth glyph in the line has a single central leg (ሞ in ወይቀውሞሙ), distinct from the two-legged ሙ immediately following it.
The final character wraps onto Column 3 Line 1 (ንኳን) to form the Amharic word እንኳን ('ያን ጊዜስ እንኳን በሱ በሌሎችም የለባቸውም'); the slightly faded glyph at the end of the line is እ, not ስ.
